result.instructions: Tools for Ideal Postcodes, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which addresses are at the postcode SW1A 1AA?"; "Find the address for '10 Downing' in SW1A and resolve the first match."; "Is the email address name@example.com deliverable?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ideal Postcodes data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run idealpostcodes_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run idealpostcodes_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run idealpostcodes_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. idealpostcodes_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: idealpostcodes_lookup_postcode
tools.title: Look up a postcode
tools.description: Return the addresses at a postcode (UK, Republic of Ireland, Netherlands, Singapore), one page at a time: page 0 holds almost every postcode, and the reply gives total. Each page costs one lookup, and an empty result is free. For a form that picks an address, prefer the find and resolve tools. Ideal Postcodes API: GET /postcodes/{postcode}.

postcode.description: A UK, Republic of Ireland, Netherlands or Singapore postcode, e.g. SW1A 1AA.

tools.name: idealpostcodes_find_address
tools.title: Find address suggestions
tools.description: Return ranked address suggestions for a partial address (typeahead). Each suggestion has an id for idealpostcodes_resolve_address. This step is free. Ideal Postcodes API: GET /autocomplete/addresses.

query.description: The partial address typed by the user, e.g. '10 Downing'.

tools.name: idealpostcodes_resolve_address
tools.title: Resolve an address
tools.description: Return the full address for a suggestion id from idealpostcodes_find_address. Costs one lookup. Ideal Postcodes API: GET /autocomplete/addresses/{address}/gbr.

address_id.description: The id of a suggestion from idealpostcodes_find_address.

tools.name: idealpostcodes_get_udprn
tools.title: Get an address by UDPRN
tools.description: Return the address for a UDPRN (8-digit Royal Mail delivery point id). Use it to refresh a stored address or to test whether it still exists (404 = not on the dataset). Costs one lookup. Ideal Postcodes API: GET /udprn/{udprn}.

tools.name: idealpostcodes_key_status
tools.title: Check this API key
tools.description: Show whether this account's API key can be used now (available), and the search contexts the key is licensed for. Free, and it shows no account data beyond the key status. Ideal Postcodes API: GET /keys/{key}.

tools.name: idealpostcodes_validate_email
tools.title: Validate an email address
tools.description: Check whether an email address is deliverable (domain resolves and has mail records). Costs one lookup when the domain is checked; 'unknown' results are free. Ideal Postcodes API: GET /emails.

email.description: The email address to check, e.g. name@example.com.

tools.name: idealpostcodes_validate_phone_number
tools.title: Validate a phone number
tools.description: Check a phone number and return its country and its national and international formats. The number needs a country code. Every query costs one lookup, also for an invalid number. Ideal Postcodes API: GET /phone_numbers.

phone_number.description: The number with its country code, e.g. +442079460000.
